label: CASE FILE · JAANCH

title: Alipore Jail ki cell 13
card: Presidency jail me kai azadi ke senani mare. Kehte hain ek cell me kuch hai — par wahan ki asli awaaz kuch aur hai.
label: CASE FILE · KALPANIK JAANCH

title: Tarapith ke shmashan ki raat
card: Ek shakti-peeth, jahan sadhna hoti hai. Raat me wahan aawazein aati hain. Hum ek pujari ke saath wahan gaye — aur woh sirf ek baat keh kar chale.
label: CASE FILE · KALPANIK JAANCH

title: Kanpur ki band kothi
card: Ek kothi jispar kisi ki maut nahi, sirf ek karza hai. Kahani chali ki wahan bhoot hai — aur ghar ki keemat utar gayi.
label: CASE FILE · KALPANIK JAANCH

title: Ullu ka chaalis raat ka jaagran
card: Kahate hain ki ullu ko chaalis raat jaagakar rakha jaaye to wo sammohit ho jaata hai — phir insaan ki tarah baat karta hai aur chhupa hua sona bata deta hai. Humne is kahani ka peecha kiya.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Kachhua ke pet mein sona
card: Ek kachhua jiski keemat chalis hazaar — kyunki “iske pet mein sona hai”. Hum us aadmi se mile jo ye kachhua bech raha tha.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Diwali ki raat, ullu ka bazaar
card: Har saal Diwali se pehle ullu ka daam badhta hai. Ye kahani kisi bhoot ki nahi — ek tijaarat ki hai, jiske hub Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra aur Allahabad hain.
label: ASLI TIJARAAT · REPORTED

title: Giddh ki haddi jo sona dhoondhti hai
card: Ek “sadhu” ne ek haddi bechi — “khazane ke paas jaakar garam ho jaati hai”. Ek hafte baad us family ne kya kiya, ye us kahani ka asli hissa hai.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Aangan ke neeche ka khazana
card: “Aapke hi aangan ke neeche sone ki tijori hai. Main jaanta hoon kahan hai.” Ek saal baad us family ke paas sirf khudai bachi thi.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Purane kuein ke sikke
card: Kuein ki safai mein sikke mile. Ek aadmi ne kaha “ye shraapit hain, mujhe do warna ghar barbaad”. Sikke asli the — shraap nahi.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Tel mein tairta hua aaina
card: Ek aaina, tel ka bartan, aur raat ka sannata — kahate hain isme khazana dikhta hai. Humne ek baar khud kiya, aur jo dikha wo sach tha, par khazana nahi.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Padosi ke aangan mein dabayi potli
card: Ek potli mili padosi ke aangan mein. Us par “kala jadu” ka ilzaam laga, aur ek gaon do hisson mein bat gaya. Potli mein kya tha, ye aage hai.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Chhalawa, ya ek bimari jiska naam nahi tha
card: Sola saal ki ladki raat mein cheekhne lagi, kisi ko pehchanne lagi nahi. Gaon ne kaha “chhalawa”. Doctor ne kuch aur kaha.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Angithi wala bhoot
card: Ek kamre mein raat ko kisi ka dum ghutne lagta tha, aur ek saaya deewar par dikhta tha. Ilzaam bhoot par — jinne asli wajah bata di.
label: LOK-MAANYATA · KALPANIK KAHANI

title: Elanthoor: jab “khazana” ke liye insaan mara gaya
card: Kerala ke ek gaon mein do auratein ek “tantrik” aur ek jode ki wajah se maari gayi — unhe bachane wala koi bhoot nahi, sirf lalach tha. Ye asli case hai.
label: ASLI GHATNA · REPORTED

title: “Ye daayan hai” — ek ilzaam ka poora hisaab
card: Ek vidhwa par daayan ka ilzaam laga. Gaon ne “ilaaj” karwaya. Ye kahani bhoot ki nahi, us zulm ki hai jo darr ke naam par hota hai.
label: ASLI GHATNA · REPORTED

title: Tantrik ka rate card
card: “Guaranteed result, 21 din.” Ek rate card, ek WhatsApp number, aur ek aisa dhandha jo darr se chalta hai. Iska pattern samajh lijiye.
label: ASLI DHANDHA · REPORTED

title: Aadhi raat, smashan, aur “siddhi” ka lalach
card: “Chalis raat smashan mein jao, siddhi mil jayegi.” Teen ladke gaye. Ek wapas nahi aaya — aur uski wajah jaadu nahi thi.
label: ASLI GHATNA · REPORTED

title: “Bachche uthane wale tantrik” ki afwaah
card: Ek afwaah ne bheed ikatthi ki, aur ek begunah aadmi ko bachana pada. Bachche ki tijaarat asli hai — par uska shikaar koi tantrik nahi hota.
label: ASLI GHATNA · REPORTED

title: Bhangarh ka shraap: India ka ghost capital
card: Khaali bazaar mein peeche sunaai diya ek kadam. Ratnavati ki sheeshi, Baba ka saaya aur ek shehar ke chhoot jaane ki kahani.

title: Kuldhara: ek raat mein ujad gayi basti
card: Maa ne ek potli baandhi. Bachche ne ek khilauna chuna. Kuldhara ki lok-katha mein ghar chhodne ki raat ko andar se mehsoos kijiye.

title: Mayong, Assam: kahaniyon ke peeche ka gaon
card: Main jaadu ka saboot dhoondhne aaya tha. Ek buzurg ne pothi kholi aur mujhse woh sawaal poochha jiski taiyaari nahi thi.

title: Shaniwar Wada: qile ki aawaz
card: “Kaka, mala vachva.” Ek aitihasik hatya, usse judi pukaar aur apnon se madad maangne ka naazuk bharosa.

title: Nishi Daak: raat ki wo awaaz jo naam leti hai
card: Bahar maa ki awaaz ne mera naam liya. Lekin maa mere bagal ki charpai par so rahi thi. Mera haath kundi tak pahunch chuka tha.

title: Naale Baa: deewaron par likhi ek prarthana
card: Darwaze par do shabd likhe the: kal aana. Raat ko bhai lauta, toh uski pehchaani awaaz par bhi yakeen nahi hua.

title: Yakshi: nariyal ke ped ke neeche khadi aurat
card: Usne sirf thodi door saath chalne ko kaha. Jo khidki paas dikh rahi thi, woh chalne par bhi paas nahi aayi.

title: Chudail / Daayan: darr ka chehra auraton ka kyun hota hai
card: Dadi ki kahani mein ulte pair the. Agli subah unhone mujhe sikhaaya ki us darr ko kisi asli insaan ka naam nahi dena.

title: Muhnochwa: 2002 ka 'chehra nochne wala'
card: Ek chamak, ek cheekh aur chhat ke kinaare tak pahunchta kadam. 2002 ki afwaah se prerit ek parivaar ki kalpanik raat.

title: Pichhla Bhoot: peeche reh gayi aahat
card: Peeche aahat thi, phir ek naam mil gaya. Ek kalpanik gaon mein afwaah aur yakeen ke beech badhta hua darr.

title: Bhulona: wo raasta jo lauta deta hai
card: Main ghar ka raasta jaanta tha. Phir wahi kuaan teesri baar saamne aaya. Is baar maine chalna band kar diya.

title: Datiyana: 'Bhootonwala Mandir'
card: Hapur ke ek mandir ki lok-katha: jis raat kisi ne banaane waalon ko nahi dekha, us subah ek imarat khadi mili.

title: Vikram aur Vetala: ek jawaab ki keemat
card: Kandhe par deh, kaan ke paas ek sawaal. Jawaab dene se raasta phir shuru hoga—lekin sahi jawaab chhupaaya kaise jaaye?

title: Monkey Man: Delhi, 2001
card: Dilli ki chhat par kisi ne chillaaya, “Aa gaya!” Maine kuch dekha nahi tha. Phir bhi main bhi bhaagne laga.

title: La Llorona: paani ke kinare rone wali
card: Nadi ke paas rona ruk gaya. Phir bahut paas se sawaal aaya: “Tumne unhe dekha?” Ek talaash jo raat se lambi hai.

title: Kuchisake-onna: mask ke peeche ka sawaal
card: Pehli baar usne poochha toh maine haan kaha. Phir usne mask hataaya. Ab wahi sawaal ek phanda lag raha tha.

title: Black Shuck: toofan mein kaala kutta
card: Toofan mein church ka darwaza hila. Sabne kuch dekha—lekin kya sabne ek hi cheez dekhi thi?
